svg.aria-label: Hard disk versus SSD: a hard disk must move its arm and wait for the platter to rotate, so a random read takes about 5–10 ms while sequential reads stream at a few hundred MB/s; an SSD has no moving parts, so random reads take about 100 µs, but it erases in large blocks, which causes write amplification.
svg.title: Hard disk versus SSD: a hard disk must move its arm and wait for the platter to rotate, so a random read takes about 5–10 ms while sequential reads stream at a few hundred MB/s; an SSD has no moving parts, so random reads take about 100 µs, but it erases in large blocks, which causes write amplification.
svg.text: write in pages, erase in big blocks
